pattern: を顧みず / も顧みず（をかえりみず / もかえりみず）
aliases: をかえりみず / もかえりみず
purpose: Act without regard for a risk, cost, or duty.
keywords: N + を顧みず / も顧みず
She went to the rescue without regard for the danger.
He immersed himself in research without regard for his own life.
They continued construction without regard for its effect on neighbors.
formation: N + を顧みず / も顧みず
restrictions: May praise courage or criticize disregard, depending on the noun.
mistake: It means not taking something into account, not merely forgetting it.
